条记忆；安装授权不自动恢复: memories; install grants are not restored automatically
编译问题排查：从最小复现开始: Debugging compile issues: start from a minimal reproduction
其他直接或继承授权仍独立生效: Other direct or inherited grants remain in effect independently

层级、记忆、安装配置与修改记录: Hierarchy, memories, installation settings, and change records
基础题专题 · 答案与解析校验: Basic problems topic · answer and explanation checks
让 AI 记住我，而不只是对话: Let AI remember me, not just the conversation
搜索名称、完整路径或记忆内容…: Search names, full paths, or memory content…
所有匹配的应用都已是最新状态。: All matching apps are up to date.
我的协作偏好：先行动，再讲清楚: My collaboration preferences: act first, then explain clearly
修改、安装与同步会记录在这里。: Changes, installs, and syncs are recorded here.
修改先保留在本机，手动更新目标: Changes stay on this device; update targets manually
条记忆 · 外部安装需重新选择: memories · external installs need to be re-selected
已撤销此项安装，后续修改停止分发: This install has been revoked; further changes stop being distributed
作用域以当前 Tree 层级为准: Scope follows the current Tree hierarchy
安装配置已保存 · 可查看分发预览: Installation settings saved · distribution preview available
本机存储空间不足，请立即导出备份。: Not enough local storage; export a backup now.
工具连接：让记忆在合适的范围内流动: Tool connections: let memories flow within the right scope
后续修改和新增后代自动同步到此目标: Future changes and new descendants sync to this target automatically
追加到当前节点；外部授权需重新选择: Appended to the current node; external grants need to be re-selected
待撤回旧版本，完成同步后移除访问。: has an old version pending retraction; access will be removed after sync completes.
记忆变化后，更新设为自动同步的安装。: When memories change, installs set to auto sync are updated.
沿着一段记忆，发现共同的语境与来处。: Follow a memory to discover shared context and origins.
只读 · 包含全部后代 · 持续同步: Read-only · including all descendants · continuous sync
Install · 将子树带到 AI: Install · bring the subtree to AI
安装时明确范围与权限，之后可以随时调整。: Set scope and permissions at install time; adjust anytime afterwards.
保存后，按所在子树的安装与同步规则分发。: After saving, distribution follows the install and sync rules of the containing subtree.
调整筛选条件，或将当前作用域安装到应用。: Adjust the filters, or install the current scope into an app.
当前子树为空；以后新增的记忆会纳入此范围。: This subtree is empty; memories added later will be included in this scope.
以下记忆仅属于所选作用域；不包含其他子树。: The following memories belong only to the selected scope; other subtrees are not included.
在 Install 中为选定的树添加应用。: Add apps to the selected tree in Install.
关系图用于理解关联，不改变树层级与安装权限。: The graph helps you understand connections; it does not change tree hierarchy or install permissions.
未安装到外部目标的内容，仅留在你的记忆树中。: Content not installed to external targets stays only in your Memory Tree.
浏览器限制了复制，请在地址栏或导出预览中复制。: The browser blocked copying; copy from the address bar or the export preview instead.
在这里查看谁能访问记忆，以及修改会同步到哪里。: See who can access memories and where changes sync.
从本地修改到应用可见，追踪每个作用域的同步状态。: Track each scope's sync status, from local change to visible in the app.
可理解、可追溯、可更新，是一条好记忆的三个标准。: Understandable, traceable, and updatable — the three criteria of a good memory.
先保存报错现场，再缩小输入；每次只改变一个条件。: Preserve the error first, then narrow the input; change one condition at a time.
答案复核完成；下一步检查长标题换行与重复提交反馈。: Answer review is complete; next, check wrapping for long titles and feedback for duplicate submissions.
记录之后，可以在这里探索记忆之间的关联与共同语境。: After recording, explore connections and shared context between memories here.
每个工具可以单独连接，并选择全部记忆或仅当前项目。: Each tool connects individually, and can use all memories or only the current project.
上午优先处理需要思考的工作，沟通与整理集中在下午。: Mornings are for work that needs thinking; communication and organizing are batched in the afternoon.
整理桌面，读完一本书，给每周留一个没有安排的下午。: Tidy the desktop, finish one book, and keep one unplanned afternoon each week.
逐题检查选项、答案与解析是否一致，边界输入单独记录。: Check every problem for consistency among options, answer, and explanation; record edge-case inputs separately.
每个应用只看到你授予的 Tree 或 Subtree。: Each app only sees the Tree or Subtree you grant.
导入失败：请选择包含有效 memories 的 JSON: Import failed: choose a JSON file containing valid memories
授权跟随子树。新增后代会继承；跨树移动前会显示访问变化。: Grants follow the subtree. New descendants inherit; access changes are shown before moving across trees.
同步路径：此 Mac，respire 云端，已安装的应用: Sync route: this Mac, respire cloud, installed apps
本地交互演示：安装配置与同步状态可操作，尚未写入外部应用。: Local interactive demo: installation settings and sync status are operable; nothing has been written to external apps yet.
此目标可以读取和修改所选子树；移动节点可能改变继承的权限。: This target can read and modify the selected subtree; moving nodes may change inherited permissions.
从关键词、语义与时间三个入口，观察人们如何重新找到一段经历。: Observe how people find an experience again through three entry points: keywords, semantics, and time.
读完后留下自己的问题、可复用的观点，以及它与现有工作的关系。: When you finish, leave your own questions, reusable ideas, and how the piece relates to your current work.
在这棵树中组织背景、偏好与决策，为每个工具提供明确的上下文。: Organize background, preferences, and decisions in this tree to give every tool clear context.
中文沟通，直接说结论；可逆的小事自行推进，关键取舍保留理由。: Communicate in Chinese and state conclusions directly; proceed on small reversible matters, and keep the reasoning behind key tradeoffs.
条记忆将被移除，绑定此范围的直接安装也会撤销。删除后可撤销。: memories will be removed, and direct installs bound to this scope will be revoked. The deletion can be undone.
低对比背景、浮动面板与清晰的文字层级；用克制的暖色强调下一步。: Low-contrast backgrounds, floating panels, and a clear text hierarchy; restrained warm color highlights the next step.
喜欢安静、有树荫、能随时停下来的路线；散步时只记录灵感关键词。: Prefers quiet, shaded routes with room to stop anytime; only inspiration keywords are noted during the walk.
左闭右开与左右闭合都可用，关键是让更新规则与退出条件保持一致。: Half-open and closed intervals both work; the key is keeping the update rules and the exit condition consistent.
本地演示：生成安装配置与分发预览，不会写入外部 AI 或 App。: Local demo: generates installation settings and a distribution preview; nothing is written to external AI or apps.
搜索、新建与关闭优先覆盖；在界面中展示快捷键，让使用习惯自然形成。: Search, create, and close take priority; show shortcuts in the interface so habits form naturally.
整理题库、校验答案与改进提交体验，将大任务拆成能够独立验收的小步骤。: Organize the problem bank, validate answers, and improve the submission experience by splitting large tasks into small steps that can be accepted independently.
此目标可以读取所选子树，不可修改；兄弟节点和祖先的其他内容不在范围内。: This target can read the selected subtree but not modify it; sibling nodes and other content of ancestors are out of scope.
直接安装跟随节点 ID；祖先授予的权限按新位置重新计算。移动后可撤销。: Direct installs follow the node ID; permissions granted by ancestors are recalculated for the new position. The move can be undone.
一个独立于工具的记忆层。让背景、偏好与做过的决定，在下一次对话里自然延续。: A memory layer independent of tools. Background, preferences, and past decisions carry over naturally into the next conversation.
所有数据保存在当前浏览器。云同步与外部安装为本地交互演示；没有连接真实服务。: All data is stored in the current browser. Cloud sync and external installs are a local interactive demo; no real service is connected.
拖拽节点到目标节点内可移动整个子树。Windows 使用 Ctrl 替代 ⌘。: Drag a node into another node to move the whole subtree. On Windows, Ctrl replaces ⌘.
子节点继承安装范围。移动或移除记忆后，同步会更新对应应用的可见内容。只读应用可使: Child nodes inherit the install scope. After memories are moved or removed, sync updates what the corresponding apps can see. Read-only apps can use the memories; read-write apps can sync changes back.
九月想把日常安排得轻一点。先整理一次桌面与下载文件夹，让常用的东西更容易找到。\:
September is for keeping the daily routine a little lighter. Start by tidying the desktop and the downloads folder once, so the things used often are easier to find.

Keep only one book in progress. Each week, write down one idea that actually made a difference, and let reading progress happen at its own pace.

Keep one unscheduled afternoon every week — for a walk, a coffee shop, or doing nothing at all. This list is a reminder to myself, not a set of tasks I must complete.
周末散步更喜欢沿河或公园里的连续步道。路线不需要太长，能够在有树荫的地方慢慢走，:
For weekend walks, I prefer an uninterrupted path along a river or through a park. The route doesn't need to be long; a slow walk in the shade with a place to sit along the way is already good.

An easy pace matters more than rushing between sights. Before going out, I only check the weather and the way back, and never pack the half-day too full.

When an idea shows up mid-walk, I jot down a few keywords and turn them into a full memory after getting home. Let the notes serve the experience, rather than keeping attention on a screen the whole time.
这一专题是九月题库迭代的一个子任务。先统一题目字段，再逐题比对选项、答案与解析，:
This topic is a subtask of the September problem bank iteration. First unify the problem fields, then compare options, answer, and explanation problem by problem, and finally check how everything renders on the page.

During validation, never revise an answer from memory. Runnable code is verified by executing it; problems that require derivation keep a short write-up of the reasoning for later review.

When edge cases appear — empty arrays, duplicate values, integer upper bounds — add them to a separate checklist. Don't only confirm that common inputs pass.

The action item this time is finishing the pre-launch check for exercise sets 313 and 314.
需要持续思考的设计、写作和问题排查，尽量安排在上午。开始前写下这一段时间希望完成:
Design, writing, and troubleshooting that need sustained thinking go into the morning when possible. Before starting, write down the concrete outcome this block should produce, to reduce ad-hoc switching.

There is no need for high-intensity focus all day long. Handle communication, reference organizing, and small maintenance in batches, and leave intact blocks of time for complex problems.

At the end, record current progress, open questions, and the next step in a few sentences. When work resumes the next day, context can be restored directly from these notes.

If the plan gets interrupted, first shrink the goal for that session and finish one meaningful piece. Making the work easier to resume is also a form of efficiency.
九月迭代围绕练习平台的内容质量与提交体验展开。将题目整理、答案校验和界面反馈分开:
The September iteration centers on the practice platform's content quality and submission experience. Problem organizing, answer validation, and interface feedback move forward separately, so that one change never carries too many unknowns.

This round of problem bank work handles basic problems first, then combined ones. Every batch keeps the original problems, explanations, and validation records, so that issues can be traced back to the specific input.

The task tree has three levels: project, topic, and action item. Parent tasks hold the goal and acceptance method, subtasks record concrete progress, and conclusions are written back to the related memories after completion.

Final acceptance watches three things: problems display in full, judging results are explainable, and a failed submission can be recovered.
实现二分查找之前，先用一句话写清楚搜索区间的含义。区间约定确定后，循环条件、边界:
Before implementing binary search, state in one sentence what the search interval means. Once the interval convention is fixed, the loop condition, boundary updates, and return position should all be derived from the same set of rules.

With a half-open interval, the right boundary may equal the array length. To find the first position that satisfies a condition, every update must strictly shrink the interval.

Check empty arrays, single elements, all-match, none-match, and duplicates separately. Don't prove correctness with a routine example that only contains distinct elements.

In code review, explain the invariant first, then read the implementation line by line. A clear invariant usually surfaces boundary problems more easily than a memorized template.
第 313 与 314 组练习已完成题干、选项和答案复核。将检查结果保存到本条执:
Exercise sets 313 and 314 have finished review of problem statements, options, and answers. The check results are saved to this action memory, the last level under the topic task.

Two easily missed details surfaced this time: long problem statements wrap awkwardly in narrow windows, and rapid repeated clicks on submit lack in-progress feedback. Both have been added to the release checklist.

Before launch, walk the real usage path once more: open an exercise, choose an answer, submit, read the explanation, return to the list. Every step should show a clear state and preserve the user's earlier choices.

After completion, update the parent task's progress, and organize reusable lessons into a separate method memory.
遇到编译或运行异常时，先保留完整报错、触发命令与相关环境信息。不要连续修改多个地:
When a compile or runtime error appears, first preserve the full error, the command that triggered it, and the related environment information. Don't change several places in a row and then try to figure out which change took effect.

Narrow the problem to a minimal example that triggers reliably. Remove code unrelated to the error, use fixed inputs, and check dependency versions and the actual working directory.

For floating-point output, separate computation precision from display precision. When fixed decimal places are needed, use fixed and setprecision explicitly, and check the output convention.

After fixing, run the minimal example first, then verify the original scenario. Record the root cause and its required conditions in memory, so that what remains is not just a context-free fix command.
默认用中文沟通，保留常用技术名词的英文写法。先说结论和下一步，再补充必要的依据，:
Communicate in Chinese by default and keep common technical terms in their English form. State the conclusion and the next step first, then add the necessary reasoning, avoiding long build-ups.

For requirements that are already clear, prioritize reversible work. At tradeoffs with a larger blast radius, lay out the options and consequences, then confirm the direction. Don't ask repeatedly about the same already-approved action.

Code delivery includes the actual changes, verification results, and remaining limitations. Design delivery should open, click, and compare — not merely describe an ideal screen.

Preferences in memory are a starting point for collaboration, not something that overrides a new, explicitly stated request. When requirements change, follow the new context first, then update this memory.
不同工具承担不同工作，所需的上下文也不同。工具连接页应该清楚展示每个连接的状态，:
Different tools do different work and need different context. The tool connections page should clearly show each connection's status and the range of memories it can use.

Everyday collaboration tools can use all memories; tools tied to a single code project can be limited to the current project only. The scope choice should stay visible at all times and remain editable.

Connecting and disconnecting both need clear feedback. Disconnecting means new memories stop flowing to that tool; users should not have to guess the current state.

The original injection management is presented as the easier-to-understand “tool connections”. Low-level integration details can stay in the details view; the main screen first answers where it is connected, whether it is healthy, and what it can use.
阅读的目标不是积累更多摘抄，而是让新的信息能够参与之后的思考。每次阅读结束，至少:
The goal of reading is not to accumulate more excerpts, but to let new information take part in later thinking. At the end of each reading session, write down at least one understanding of your own.

A useful note contains its source, the core idea, and the conditions where it applies. For an author's conclusions, distinguish direct evidence, inference, and personal judgment instead of mixing them.

When organizing notes, look for their connection to existing questions. An article on information retrieval, for example, can link to the respire search experience; research on cognitive load can help explain tradeoffs in the interface.

The parts not yet thought through are worth keeping too. A precise question is more useful than a summary that looks complete but was never digested.
个人记忆的检索常常从模糊线索开始。人们可能只记得讨论过的话题、使用的工具，或者大:
Retrieving a personal memory often starts from vague clues. A person may remember the topic discussed, the tool used, or roughly when it happened, but not the original title.

Explore three complementary entry points: keywords fit known targets, semantic descriptions fit fuzzy intent, and time and project fit narrowing down step by step. The design can combine them, but should not require users to understand the retrieval mechanics first.

Results show a snippet that explains “why it matched”, with source and time preserved. Users should be able to judge quickly whether they found the memory they need.

Follow-up validation focuses on completion rate and time spent on real retrieval tasks. This entry is a research hypothesis, not yet a proven conclusion.
记忆库的价值不由记录总数决定。真正有用的记忆，应该能够被正确找到，并在合适的上下:
A memory library's value is not decided by the total number of records. A truly useful memory can be found correctly and helps action in the right context.

First, understandable: it still makes sense once separated from the original chat. Avoid saving only “this will do” — fill in the subject, the conditions, and the outcome.

Second, traceable: know where the content came from, when it took shape, and why it is worth keeping. Third, updatable: when preferences change, a project ends, or experience expires, it can be revised instead of endlessly stacking contradictory records.

When tidying, merge duplicate phrasings first and keep the key differences. For conflicting memories, show time and source first, then let the user decide which one remains in effect.
桌面应用的快捷键从最常用的三条路径开始：搜索记忆、新建记忆、关闭当前浮层。每个快:
A desktop app's shortcuts start with the three most common paths: search memories, create a memory, close the current overlay. Every shortcut should map to a visible interface action.

Command + K opens search, and results appear as you type. Command + N opens the new window and focuses the first input field. Escape closes the current overlay layer by layer and returns to the original reading position.

While editing, keep normal text operations working and do not take over keys that input controls rely on. Shortcut hints sit next to buttons or menus, not on a separate help page.

When verifying, check the mouse path and the keyboard path together. How effortless an action feels depends on the whole journey from the current state to the result.
这次桌面体验采用接近纸张的浅灰底色。内容面板用轻微的明暗和柔和投影区分，不依赖密:
This desktop experience uses a paper-like light gray base. Content panels are distinguished by subtle shading and soft shadows, not by dense borders dividing space.

Color carries a clear function: warm apricot marks current focus and primary actions, while other category colors serve only as light hints. State is not expressed by color alone — text or icons accompany it, so information stays easy to understand.

Common paths on Mac stay short enough: Command + K to search, Command + N to create, Escape to close the overlay. Search results go straight into a memory, and a way back is always kept while reading.

The reading area cuts decoration and keeps comfortable line length. Important information surfaces naturally through headings, paragraphs, and a few tags — not every block becomes a loud card.
核心想法\n让记忆跟着人走。换一个 AI，也不用再介绍一遍自己。\n\n一次教会:
Core idea
Let memory follow the person. Switch to another AI, and there is no need to introduce yourself all over again.

Teach once, understood everywhere
What I want AI to remember is not just “what was said”, but why I did things that way. Preferences, decisions, and experience should become personal context that keeps accumulating.

About me: preferences and ways of working, no need to explain repeatedly.
About current work: the project and the path behind each decision, ready to pick up anytime.
Brought to every AI: settle once, reuse on every device, and the accumulation always stays yours.

Three things I care about in the design
01 See content first, tools second. Keep recording and reading effortless, and tuck complex configuration away until it is needed.
02 Every memory has an origin. Keep source, connections, and time, so AI's understanding can be traced and corrected.
03 Memory belongs to me, and I decide where it goes. Choose the connection scope by context; view, edit, and export anytime.
